_comment: Ready-made collision setups. 'params' are EventParams fields; 'look' are scene options (camera preset, camera move). Every system listed here has its multiplicity, flow and freeze-out inputs in the data tables, either measured directly or via the documented fallbacks (see docs/validation.md 'Data sources per case').

PbPb_5020_central.label: Pb-Pb 5.02 TeV, 0-5%
PbPb_5020_central.description: LHC Run 2, most central: largest, hottest, longest-lived QGP; nearly round overlap, small v2.

PbPb_5020_midcentral.label: Pb-Pb 5.02 TeV, 30-40%
PbPb_5020_midcentral.description: Almond-shaped overlap; the orbit ends near the beam axis where the elliptic flow (v2 ~ 0.1) is visible.

PbPb_5020_peripheral.label: Pb-Pb 5.02 TeV, 60-70%
PbPb_5020_peripheral.description: Grazing collision: few participants, many spectators, short-lived droplet (least accurate class of the Level-A model).

OO_5360_central.label: O-O 5.36 TeV, 0-5%
OO_5360_central.description: LHC 2025 light-ion run: a QGP droplet from 16+16 nucleons.

AuAu_200_central.label: Au-Au 200 GeV, 0-5%
AuAu_200_central.description: RHIC top energy: thicker pancakes (gamma ~ 107), cooler and shorter QGP than at the LHC.

AuAu_200_midcentral.label: Au-Au 200 GeV, 30-40%
AuAu_200_midcentral.description: RHIC almond; orbit to the beam view to see the elliptic flow.

AuAu_62_central.label: Au-Au 62.4 GeV, 0-5%
AuAu_62_central.description: Lower RHIC energy: gamma ~ 33, the nuclei are visibly thicker discs.

UU_193_tiptip.label: U-U 193 GeV, tip-tip, b = 0
UU_193_tiptip.description: Prolate U-238 with symmetry axes along the beam: round overlap, highest multiplicity, small eps2 (STAR PRL 115 222301 geometry).

UU_193_bodybody.label: U-U 193 GeV, body-body, b = 0
UU_193_bodybody.description: Symmetry axes perpendicular to beam and b: elongated overlap and large eps2 even at zero impact parameter.

NeNe_5360_central.label: Ne-Ne 5.36 TeV, 0-5%
NeNe_5360_central.description: LHC 2025 run with strongly deformed Ne-20 (beta2 = 0.72, 'bowling pin'); compare with O-O.

pPb_5020_central.label: p-Pb 5.02 TeV, 0-5%
pPb_5020_central.description: A proton hits a lead nucleus: a small, short-lived droplet that still shows collective flow (v2 ~ 0.06).

dAu_200_central.label: d-Au 200 GeV, 0-5%
dAu_200_central.description: RHIC small-system geometry scan: a deuteron (two nucleons, Hulthen wave function) on gold.

He3Au_200_central.label: 3He-Au 200 GeV, 0-5%
He3Au_200_central.description: Three-nucleon projectile: triangular initial geometry, enhanced v3 (PHENIX Nature Phys. 15 (2019) 214).

CuAu_200_central.label: Cu-Au 200 GeV, 0-5%
CuAu_200_central.description: Asymmetric collision: the small Cu nucleus is fully absorbed inside Au, giving a dipole-shaped fireball.

AuAu_19_central.label: Au-Au 19.6 GeV, 0-5% (beam energy scan)
AuAu_19_central.description: RHIC BES: gamma ~ 10, the nuclei are only ~10x flattened and take ~1.3 fm/c to pass. Outside the model's comfort zone (boost invariance, mu_B = 0 EoS); see the HUD warning.
